about: What pairtime knows about an executable, shared by the Windows, macOS and Linux code. app_class is the os.focus class of a window the executable owns (SM 1.2, 2.5, 3.2). role is its part in a parent chain, which decides a harness session's parent_class (SM 1.2, 2.2 rule 4). Names are lowercase executable base names without .exe; a trailing * matches any rest. Shells and harnesses carry app_class terminal because on Windows a classic console window belongs to its first client process, such as powershell.exe or claude.exe, and not to conhost.exe, which is why conhost isn't listed; on Linux and macOS they own no window. appclass.go documents every field, and appclass_test.go checks every entry.
